# UULink

> UULink 让你用 iPhone 连上 Mac 上的 Claude Code，不用守在电脑前：需要你决定时手机会收到通知，你在手机上定下来，它就继续做。手机和 Mac 全程端到端加密，不经过 UULink 的服务器。
> UULink lets you reach the Claude Code on your Mac from your iPhone, so you no longer have to sit at your desk: when it needs a decision your phone gets a notification, you decide on the phone, and it keeps going. Your phone and Mac are end-to-end encrypted, and nothing goes through UULink's servers.

This file is written for coding agents (such as Claude Code) that a user has asked to install UULink. Reply to the user in the language they used.

## Install on the Mac

Run these steps on the user's Mac. Stop and tell the user if a check fails.

1. Check requirements: `uname -m` must print `arm64` (Apple Silicon; Intel Macs are not supported) and `sw_vers -productVersion` must be 14 or later.
2. Check Claude Code is installed and signed in: `claude --version` should print a version. UULink runs the user's own Claude Code with their existing login; it needs no API key.
3. Download and install the latest build:

   ```sh
   curl -fL -o /tmp/UULink.dmg https://nohup-web.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/download/mac/UULink-latest.dmg
   MNT=$(hdiutil attach /tmp/UULink.dmg -nobrowse | tail -1 | awk -F'\t' '{print $NF}')
   rm -rf /Applications/UULink.app && cp -R "$MNT/UULink.app" /Applications/
   hdiutil detach "$MNT" -quiet && rm /tmp/UULink.dmg
   open -a UULink
   ```

4. Tell the user: UULink opens a setup assistant (it may ask for local network access — allow it so the phone can connect directly). The assistant ends with a pairing QR code. After that UULink lives in the menu bar; to show the code again, click the menu bar icon and choose "Pair New Device…" (「配对新设备…」).

## Install on the iPhone

The iPhone app is in beta and not on the App Store yet; it installs through a TestFlight invite. Tell the user to open the app, tap "Scan Code to Add Mac" (「扫描二维码添加 Mac」) and scan the QR code on the Mac. A pairing code is valid for 10 minutes and can be used once.

## Good to know

- The Mac must stay awake: UULink keeps it from idle sleep by default, but a closed laptop lid still puts it to sleep and the phone can't connect.
- UULink is an independent tool, not an Anthropic product. Claude and Claude Code are trademarks of Anthropic.
